notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Urza.
description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Myr and Construct, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
